entities.name: Hound
entities.canon: Fast aggressive four-limbed predator. Hunts humans, often in groups, and exploits isolation, injury and constrained routes.

entities.name: Clump
entities.canon: Mass of limbs and muscle that ambushes from dark recesses, technical gaps and crawlspaces and drags humans out of formation.

entities.name: Duller
entities.canon: Distorted humanoid Entity that watches before approaching and exploits concrete-column blind spots.

entities.name: Deathmoth
entities.canon: Large moth-like predator that uses dark ceilings and technical recesses and reacts to light and movement.

entities.name: Hostile Faceling
entities.canon: Human-shaped faceless predator. Apparent human-like behavior only reduces vigilance before it hunts.

entities.name: False Puddle
entities.canon: Predator mimicking a flat puddle of Almond Water. It reacts to human footsteps and opens a toothed mouth when prey steps on it.

entities.name: Paintings
entities.canon: Predatory paintings whose depicted beings can watch, reach beyond the surface and pull victims into the image.

entities.name: Smiler
entities.canon: Darkness-using predator seen mainly as a bright face-like feature. It can pressure prey into choosing a bad route rather than charging immediately.

entities.name: Skin-Stealer
entities.canon: Human-mimicking predator capable of deep disguise and long infiltration. Human appearance never proves a contact is human.

entities.name: Predatory Window
entities.canon: A window-like predatory manifestation in impossible locations that lures humans close and can reach through an unreliable apparent space.

entities.name: Biological Pipeline
entities.canon: Huge organic/mechanical pipeline-like predator that senses vibration and heat, offers false safe routes, traps retreat and can secrete tissue-corrosive alkaline liquid.

entities.name: Wretch
entities.canon: Irregular, pain-tolerant predator believed or suspected to have once been human. It tracks prey through sound and scent.

entities.name: Cable Mimic
entities.canon: Entity that blends into electrical cable bundles, waits motionless, then wraps limbs and can conduct facility current through a victim.

entities.name: The Beast of Level 5
entities.canon: Apex Level 5 Entity with above-human intelligence that hunts humans through long observation, isolation and manipulation of hotel architecture.

entities.name: Hotel Corpse Lure
entities.canon: Level 5 corpse-lure phenomenon or Entity that can preserve heat, voice, movement or useful-looking clues to draw humans closer.

entities.name: Jeff the Killer
entities.canon: Very rare roaming humanoid predator permitted as an incursion across Levels 0–6. It hunts humans and may conduct long tactical observation.
